# netactuate_dedicated_server_ipv4_reverse (Resource)

Manages reverse DNS for one dedicated server IPv4 address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_dedicated_server_ipv4_reverse" "example" {
  ipv4_id = 12345
  mbpkgid = 12345
  reverse = "host.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4_id` (Number) Dedicated server IPv4 address ID.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Dedicated server package ID.
- `reverse` (String) Reverse DNS hostname.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_dedicated_server_ipv4_reverse.example 12345
```
